steps.content: He's not what I expected, I thought he'd be more assertive. Why does he look even weaker than when he was unconscious?
steps.female_content: She's not what I expected, I thought she'd be more assertive. Why does she look even weaker than when she was unconscious?

steps.content: He probably doesn't know yet. That bastard from the Paradeisos wanted me to free him... Now I found him, but I'm about to do the exact opposite.
steps.female_content: She probably doesn't know yet. That bastard from the Paradeisos wanted me to free her... Now I found her, but I'm about to do the exact opposite.

steps.content: Why are you staring at me and laughing?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: It's a long-awaited reunion. Shouldn't you be happy to see an old friend?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Or is it because...
Coquelic takes a strand of her hair, playfully twirling it like teasing a cat.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Don't tell me you've forgotten about me after a good night's sleep, Chief.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ah, that's a pity.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You probably only remember the beautiful girl in the moonlit flower field, but forgot about the imposing villain behind the screen.
Was that really you? ...We didn't exactly "meet" since there was a screen between us.
After Sinner Sumire's first escape, I brought her back from the "Mentor."
But the Mentor was behind the screen at that time. How can you prove that "Mentor" was you?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Don't be such a killjoy. A close relationship benefits both of us!
She teasingly moves closer to you, trying to touch you while ignoring her wounds.
You instantly distance yourself from her. This isn't a simple "seduction," your shackles clearly sense a rising surge of Mania, constantly tangling with the shackles.
The shackles can suppress Mania. You don't have to fight it.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You're so serious. I was just teasing you. I just wanted to test if the legendary leash is as sturdy as they say... Don't be so petty, Sinners don't like that.
It seems like she gives in, but her body language and M-value say otherwise.
Alright, if you want to "play" with the shackles, you can. But you have to play a game with me too.
Tell me everything you know about the incidents that occurred in Eastside while I was unconscious. We'll exchange information.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Here I thought you would ask for something else. Fine, I'll tell you.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: A carnation under my command was deceived and took on a dangerous commission.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I couldn't stand seeing my little flower being tormented, so I helped her out.
She casually narrates, fiddling with her nails.
Don't play dumb, that won't work here.
Who commissioned you?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The client? It doesn't matter anymore, you can't find her. She broke the rules and dragged the little flowers of the Garden into a mess. She already turned into compost.
Who was your target?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Shalom, a scumbag from Paradeisos. And also, to mess with FAC a little bit.
Why target her?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: A good assassin wouldn't ask anything unnecessary.
...Then why dragged others into this?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Just a justice ceremony done along the way.
Do you know anything about the inside story?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: No, I don't.
She adjusts into a comfortable pose on the interrogation chair. She subtly moves her fingers towards you while blinking innocently.
Coquelic doesn't trust you. You can tell by her perfunctory attitude.
For a commission you know nothing about, you let the Garden confront Paradeisos. It's almost completely destroyed.
You were willing to pay such a high price, and you think I'll believe you know nothing?
You distance yourself from Coquelic, placing a thick stack of evidence in front of her.
test
test
test
test
test
test

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Let's see what our little Chief has found.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Oh... "Since the establishment of the Garden, their main targets have always been the Paradeisos and the anti-Mania combat personnel. The source of the Garden's weapons and supplies is deeply connected to the Underground."

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: "They can even use unknown means to catalyze ordinary people into Sinners. Currently, the only known possessors of this technology are..."
Parma, and—

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Their master, the Underground, hahaha!
She can't stop laughing at your serious expression.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You knew everything already. Why are you still playing this game with me?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Yes, there once was a group of self-righteous people who nurtured this place, manipulated the puppets known as "Mentors," and recruited those poor little flowers.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I was once one of them, recruited by my "Mentor" and inspired by her. I wielded my power for her.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: But they forgot one thing: flowers and dogs are different. We are not the same as Parma. Some flowers are poisonous...
She takes the investigation report in your hand, and looks at your various speculations about the Underground. As if it's some worthless trash, she scatters the report on the ground.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I don't like working for others, and I hate those self-proclaimed manipulators even more.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: So, I presented the most splendid performance for the "Mentor"! Using the quickest, harshest, and most painful method she taught me, I took away everything she had.
Including the position of the "Mentor."

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You're such a clever child, Chief. If only my Garden had more people like you...
She giggles softly, and gets a bit closer to you.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: But I'm just a kind and beautiful young woman. Even if I sit in the position of the "Mentor," I still can't escape the control of the Underground.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Remember the client I just mentioned?
Didn't you say she's already turned into "compost"?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ah, I almost forgot, before she turned into something useful, she had her own name—Segal.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: She, like those in the Parma, can decay into a disgusting sludge.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You see, I'm busy. I don't have time to care about the life of sludge.
Coquelic props her cheek and looks at you, as if she's waiting for an interesting answer.
Sludge can regenerate. I've seen something similar.
You mean, this Segal who was sent by the Underground to liaise with the Garden might still be alive?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: That depends on you... Good luck, little Chief.
You just called yourself young...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Rude! Never ask a delicate flower for its age.
She's just pretending to be upset, and she quickly restores her usual inscrutable smile. Her cold pale hands are holding you.
Having physical contact with an assassin will only put me in danger, right?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: But you aren't pulling away. Are you still expecting me to say something?
You haven't told the whole truth yet.
Although she's injured, she's still an S-Class Sinner. You can't push her away, and her cold knuckles are moving up along your arm.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I've been so cooperative, so don't reject me. The intel I gave you should keep you busy for a while.
You did give me some useful information, but you haven't told the whole truth yet, have you?
If you don't like being controlled by the Underground, why accept this commission?
After finding yourself caught up in a dispute, laying low seems more like an assassin's style. What were you trying to do here?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You have so many questions... But, isn't this different from the "information exchange" we agreed on?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Perhaps it's time for you to show me your sincerity...
Coquelic points at the red glow on her, feigning innocence.
What do you want to know?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hmm... First, explain how it <color=#fb9259>binds</color> Sinners.
Although it's named "shackles," I've never considered it as a restraint.
I only use it to suppress the Mania in Sinners, not to "bind" anyone.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Oh? Even if the Sinner tries to harm you with their power, you won't force them to stop?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Like this, for example?
Coquelic's nails dig deep into your wrist, and you start to feel a sharp pain.
You seem so hostile, but you chose to be detained by MBCC... What exactly do you want to gain from me?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Gain? Don't be ridiculous. It's not like you would agree to it if I told you.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Dear Chief, as long as you're alive, the shackles can never be broken, right?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You have such an unreasonable power. Stop with the pretty words!
The shackles are scorching. A sinister power is constantly emanating from her end.
You have to gather more information, so you keep your hand there.
How would you know whether we're allies if you don't tell the truth?
If the Underground dragged the Garden into this to divert FAC's attention... what about you?
You accepted the commission, exposed the Underground, surrendered to us, and are now testing the limits of the shackles... Are you really doing all these on a whim?
Tell me what you want. I can help you.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I don't need you, big hero. The Garden only blooms for itself!
You feel a more intense pain, as though roots are starting to grow into your soil. You can feel beads of sweat forming on your forehead.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Just like I joined the Garden without a reason, I just despise all forms of restraint!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: FAC and Paradeisos hindered the growth of the flowers. Breaking free from them is just what I want!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: This is my Garden! It thrives freely and fervently within its season!
Obstacles and restraints, do they include MBCC and me?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hahahaha... Congratulations, you guessed it! But it's too late!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You'll be my final work! You will die, along with the restraints and fate you symbolize, with me!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Cough, cough, cough...!
The backlash of Mania on her is exceptionally strong. Her skin is scorching hot. But she shows no intention of letting go, and her power is wandering rudely inside you.
Unlike a Corpus, whose presence can be easily detected, this feels more like a smoke of decay, arbitrarily invading your mind.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Aren't you going to use your precious shackles to restrain me?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Bind me! Make me stop! Show me your anger, your oppression!
Stop it, Coquelic. If you keep going, neither of us will be able to bear it!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hehehe, cough, cough! ...I've lived a great life. Now I just want to see, between your shackles and this, who will see the sun of tomorrow!
Pain spreads from your arm to your heart and lungs, even affecting all your organs. Dizziness, nausea, chill... All horrible experiences envelop you, and you start to tremble uncontrollably.
Coquelic isn't faring much better, but she seems to be numb to it all. She's burning her own life and excitedly watching your pained expression.
She was clearly exhausted after the fight. Where is this power coming from now...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: It's power extracted at the expense of my own life... Do you like it? This domineering, filthy, deathly power! It's been inside me, stunting my growth, consuming my mind...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: If you like it, I have plenty more! I made a pact with Mania a long time ago. This disgusting power is inexhaustible for me!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I'll use this disgusting power to rip off your hypocritical mask under your pretty words!
How many times do I have to tell you... The shackles aren't meant for restraining Sinners!
But someone has to control your Mania!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ha... I knew it...!
She weakly lifts her eyes, smirking as she looks at the dark red thorns around her.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I knew it, you people with missions and titles love to talk big! In the end, you released the shackles anyway!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You may fool the other girls, but you can't fool me...
The taste of blood fills your throat, making you increasingly irritated.
I have been telling the truth from the beginning, but look at you! You're about to die, and you're still talking nonsense?
Stop being so stubborn. Control your Mania and calm down!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Heh... Are you trying to... prove your kindness to a Sinner...
She murmurs weakly, her thoughts drifting away. She thinks of the Sinners who successfully escaped the Garden, and a future without the Chief.
She brushes the sweaty bangs off your forehead, leans close to your ear, and with a smile, says her last words.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Join me, let Mania... consume us completely...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: They have such high expectations for you... I'm looking forward to seeing... the brilliant expressions of those bastards... after you're exhausted...
The pain penetrates your marrow, and your consciousness, along with hers, falls into the abyss.
When Nightingale arrives with the guards and the medical team, all they find are an unconscious Chief and Coquelic. A poppy is blooming where their skin had made contact.
That is the mark left by a Garden assassin after achieving their goal.
